name: Everwood Furnishings
old_description: Premium polywood furniture, handcrafted for durability, beauty, and low-maintenance living. Designed to elevate patios, parks, porches, and everything in between.
about:
Everwood Furnishings operates from St Ignatius, Montana, where it handcrafts premium polywood furniture for outdoor living spaces. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, but its focus on domestic manufacturing and recycled materials has defined its operation since inception.

The manufacturer produces outdoor furniture — including gliders, tables, and seating — using poly lumber, a material made from 95 percent recycled plastic such as milk jugs and detergent bottles. Each piece is shaped by hand and assembled with stainless steel fasteners that resist saltwater and weather corrosion. The process yields furniture that does not crack, warp, rot, or fade, and requires no painting or sealing, offering a low‑maintenance alternative to traditional wood.

Everwood sells exclusively through a wholesale network, supplying dealers who serve residential and commercial customers for patios, parks, porches, and other outdoor settings. The company does not sell directly to end consumers, instead directing buyers to its dealer network or downloadable catalog.

The business states its primary aim is to bring glory to God, with customer satisfaction as a secondary goal. It differentiates itself by using 95 percent recycled content, corrosion‑resistant hardware, and a wholesale‑only model that supports dealer partners, positioning itself as part of a “green earth revolution” that repurposes post‑consumer plastic.

name: Evolution Graphix
old_description: We pride ourselves in the quality of work that we provide to customers with our embroidery services. We have invested in top-of-the-line equipment for high quality embroidery. We have 4…
about:
Evolution Graphix is a small apparel and graphics company based in Hermon, Maine. The business was started by Troy, a civil engineer, and Nikki, a registered nurse, who wanted to own and operate their own company to control quality, customer service, and deadlines. They describe the venture as pursuing the American dream of working for themselves.

The company provides custom decoration and fabrication services including embroidery, sublimation, direct-to-film (DTF) digital printing, decal production, banner and sign printing, custom cornhole board manufacturing, and laser etching. They operate with a Cobraflex DTF printer and other top-of-the-line embroidery equipment, producing items such as decorated apparel, coated substrates, birch plywood and red oak cornhole boards, stainless steel travel mugs, and leather patches.

Their customer base includes fraternal organizations such as the Widows Sons and Anah Shrine, educational institutions like Hermon Hawks for spirit wear, and sports teams such as The Maine Threat. They also run a dedicated Masonic gear site, MasonicME.com, and donate products and time to support fundraising efforts for these groups.

The founders emphasize control over quality, service, and deadlines as their motivation. They highlight their commitment to community giving, donating over $30,000 annually through their fraternal affiliations, and aim to expand their design offerings across multiple genres while remaining open to customer ideas.

name: Exotic Wood Depot LLC
old_description: Exotic Wood Depot — Premium Exotic Wood & Custom Woodworking in Orlando, Florida
about:
Exotic Wood Depot LLC operates from a showroom and workshop in Orlando, Florida. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed in public materials, and no individual founders are named.

The business functions as both a custom woodworking shop and a supplier of exotic hardwood slabs. Its capabilities include designing and building live-edge tables, epoxy river tables, dining and conference tables, bar tops, countertops, floating shelves, fireplace mantels, custom desks, and specialty furniture. The shop also provides slab flattening, finishing, and sourcing services. Inventory listed on the site shows dozens of large slabs — primarily Guanacaste Parota and Monkeypod, with additional species such as Brazilian Cedar, Pachote, Timburi, spalted maple, walnut, and figured maple — ranging from roughly 8 to 13 feet in length.

Customers include homeowners, interior designers, general contractors, builders, restaurant owners, and other businesses throughout Central Florida, covering Orlando, Winter Park, Lake Mary, Sanford, Kissimmee, Clermont, Apopka, Altamonte Springs, Oviedo, Winter Garden, and surrounding communities. Projects shown range from residential dining tables and coffee tables to commercial bar tops, kitchen islands, and conference tables.

The company states that it differentiates itself by selecting wood for figure, stability, and character, aiming to preserve the natural story of each board while delivering functional, durable pieces. It emphasizes a collaborative design process tailored to each client’s vision, style, and space, rejecting mass-produced approaches in favor of one-of-a-kind craftsmanship.

name: Expert Apparel Manufacturing
old_description: Expert Apparel Manufacturing is a highly experienced and skilled Dallas-based garment manufacturer and development house specializing in the production of clothing and textile products.
about:
Expert Apparel Manufacturing is a Dallas, Texas-based garment manufacturer and development house that reports over 13 years of production experience. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founder names.

The company provides end-to-end apparel manufacturing, handling fabric and accessory sourcing, pattern creation, sample development, bulk production, quality inspections, packaging, and shipping. Its Dallas factory runs a no-minimum production line capable of both small-batch and high-volume orders, serving categories from women's ready-to-wear and swimwear to athletic wear, menswear, luxury ready-to-wear, and childrenswear. EAM also offers rework services for brands producing overseas that need stateside correction of damaged or rejected goods.

EAM works with U.S.-based fashion brands ranging from startup labels to established companies, including those reshoring production from Asia and Europe. The company has assisted clients nationwide in launching and growing their collections, with a recent focus on luxury ready-to-wear and childrenswear segments. It also supports overseas-producing brands that require domestic rework on defective goods.

The company emphasizes its no-minimum policy, quick turnaround times, and all-in-house production as key differentiators from overseas factories. Its stated mission includes rebuilding the Dallas-Fort Worth garment manufacturing base, advocating for domestic production, and improving worker wages and conditions. EAM also highlights ethical quality control, sustainability efforts such as waste reduction and fabric recycling, and a partnership approach to each project.

name: Exterior Metals, Inc.
old_description: From high-quality metal roofing panels to all necessary accessories, we've got you covered.
about:
Exterior Metals, Inc. operates from South Prairie, Washington, where it has served as an architectural sheet metal specialist for over 30 years. The company’s origins trace back to a focus on metal roofing and siding, though specific founding details and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides a range of sheet metal services, including metal roofing and siding packages, architectural sheet metal installation for commercial and industrial projects, and specialized custom fabrication. It also designs and engineers cold-formed steel buildings that are fully customizable, offering both pre-engineered and custom options. All fabrication is performed in-house, though facility size and production volumes are not specified.

Exterior Metals primarily serves commercial and industrial construction markets, working with contractors and project owners who require architectural sheet metal components, roofing systems, and custom metal building structures. The company’s installation services cover both custom and pre-engineered systems for these sectors.

The company emphasizes durability, efficiency, and total customization as core differentiators, positioning its cold-formed steel buildings as an alternative to pre-made structures. It highlights a commitment to maximizing efficiency and minimizing costs while delivering precise, high-quality metalwork.

Extreme Wood Works of South Florida, Inc. operates from Doral, Florida, as a family-owned and operated business. The company emphasizes a personal touch, treating customers as extended family.

The shop produces custom residential and commercial millwork, including kitchens, bathrooms, retail displays, office fixtures, and architectural woodworking. It offers fully customizable solutions covering size, shape, color, and material selection, and integrates hardware such as Richelieu products. The facility handles both wood and metal fabrication, including custom metal extrusions, though the core focus remains on woodworking and furniture-grade craftsmanship.

Extreme Wood Works highlights four differentiators: full customization, high-quality materials and workmanship, flexibility in design options, and competitive pricing on bespoke work. The family-owned structure is cited as the foundation for its customer-care approach.

name: Extron
old_description: DTP3 Wallplate Transmitter Puts USB-C and HDMI Connections Right Where You Need Them
about:
Extron is headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina, where it designs and manufactures professional audiovisual equipment for installed applications. The company operates globally with localized websites and support across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia‑Pacific.

Its product portfolio centers on signal processing and distribution for ProAV systems: seamless scaling matrix switchers, HDMI and USB‑C extenders, control processors, audio de‑embedders, and AV‑over‑IP solutions. The catalog includes compact wallplate transmitters, multi‑format switchers with 8K support, and networked AV platforms such as the NAV series. Extron also publishes design guides and runs a training program for system integrators and technicians.

Customers span education, healthcare, corporate enterprise, live‑event production, and government sectors. Recent case studies reference esports labs at Indiana State University, surgical education at The Faculty Clinic in Stockholm, and dental instruction at International Medical University in Malaysia. The company sells directly and through a network of authorized resellers and integrators worldwide.

Extron emphasizes interoperability and standards‑based design, offering resources like the Professional AV over IP Design Guide and 802.1X primers to help specifiers deploy reliable, secure networks. A three‑year parts‑and‑labor warranty covers most hardware, and the firm maintains a dedicated support hotline for technical assistance.

name: F&H Food Equipment Co.
old_description: In 1959, Wilbur Feagan and Paul Higley pooled their resources to hand deliver parts & supplies to small dairies and cheese plants.
about:
F&H Food Equipment Co. began in 1959 in St. Joseph, Missouri, when Wilbur Feagan and Paul Higley pooled their resources to hand-deliver dairy parts and supplies to local cheese plants and dairies. The company transitioned to employee ownership in 1995 when Feagan transferred the business to his workforce, and today it operates as a 100% employee-owned enterprise headquartered in Springfield, Missouri.

The company distributes sanitary processing equipment from brands such as SPX Flow, Rubber Fab, and Haynes Lubricants, while also providing in-house services including pump and valve repair, engineering and fabrication, CNC machining, custom stainless steel fabrication through its MecTec division, installation, and on-site training. F&H maintains 13 locations across the United States, with its Springfield headquarters housing warehouse, repair, fabrication, and machining operations, and serves customers internationally.

F&H serves processing facilities in food and beverage, dairy, beer/wine/spirits, pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical, personal care, pet food, and other hygienic and industrial applications. Its customer base ranges from small dairies to large-scale processors across the U.S. and abroad.

The company emphasizes that employee ownership aligns incentives toward collaborative problem-solving rather than individual commissions, and that long employee tenure preserves technical knowledge. F&H positions itself as a single source for equipment, parts, repair, engineering, and fabrication when off-the-shelf solutions fall short.

name: F/LIST USA Colorado
old_description: Luxuriöse Innenausstattungen für Business- & Privatjets, Commercial Aviation und exklusive Residenzen.
about:
F/LIST USA Colorado operates from Westminster, Colorado, as the American outpost of a family-owned enterprise founded in 1950 by the father of Franz List in Austria. What began as a modest carpentry workshop grew under Franz List's leadership into a globally operating company with high-end manufactories worldwide. The supervisory board chairman and visionary Franz List passed away in March 2024 at age 76, leaving a legacy of craftsmanship and innovation that continues to drive the business.

The company designs and manufactures luxurious interior fittings for business and private jets, commercial aviation, and exclusive residences. Its worldwide high-end manufactories produce custom cabin interiors, combining traditional handcraftsmanship with material innovation. Showcase projects include the F/LAB Morphing Table, the Cottage K residence, and the Global 6000 aircraft interior, demonstrating capabilities across aviation and high-end residential sectors.

Clients span private jet owners, commercial aviation operators, and luxury residential developers seeking bespoke interior solutions. The company serves the business aviation, private aviation, commercial aviation, and exclusive residential markets, with concrete project examples including the Bombardier Global 6000 cabin and custom residential installations.

F/LIST distinguishes itself by challenging the physical limits of materials and design to create never-before-seen interior elements. The company emphasizes its family-values foundation, a culture of passionate craftsmanship, and a commitment to actively shaping the future of luxury interiors through innovation.

name: FCS Automotive International-NV
old_description: Shocks, struts, lift supports & fleet air springs — built by the manufacturer’s manufacturer.
about:
FCS Automotive International is headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, and operates as a vertically integrated manufacturer of ride control products. The company describes itself as "the manufacturer's manufacturer," designing and producing shocks, struts, lift supports, and air suspension components for original equipment suppliers worldwide.

The company produces complete strut assemblies, bare shocks and struts, lift supports, electronic lift supports, and air suspension systems for light-duty vehicles, plus heavy-duty gas shocks and air springs for commercial fleets. With over 60 full-time engineers on staff, FCS maintains end-to-end control from design through quality testing, including durability and reliability validation. Distribution centers in Madison Heights, Michigan; Suwanee, Georgia; and Rancho Cucamonga, California support North American delivery. Recent expansions added 32 new part numbers in February 2026 and 105 new numbers in June 2025, extending coverage to more than 20 million vehicles in the U.S. and Canada.

FCS serves the North American automotive aftermarket, where it claims leadership in complete strut assembly coverage, as well as heavy-duty fleets including Freightliner, International, Kenworth, Mack, and Volvo. The company also supplies OE manufacturers globally, positioning itself as a primary source for ride control components.

FCS emphasizes vertical integration, a large engineering team, OE benchmark pedigree, and value pricing as its core differentiators, stating that complete control over manufacturing and testing allows it to meet or exceed OE specifications at competitive cost.
